hero.title: Your everyday companion for
hero.body: Track your mood, journal privately, talk to mentors and find people who get it. Made for students and young professionals in Bangladesh.

mockup.ariaLabel: Preview of the Bondhu app showing a mood check-in, a weekly mood chart, a breathing exercise and a journal prompt

features.title: Small daily habits. Real support.
features.subtitle: Bondhu brings the tools that help you feel better and grow into one friendly app.

mood.title: Mood tracking
mood.body: Check in with one tap and see your patterns across weeks and months.

journal.title: Private journal
journal.body: Guided prompts in Bangla and English. Only you can read what you write.

mentors.title: Mentor sessions
mentors.body: Book time with mentors for career, study and life questions.

community.title: The Adda
community.body: Share anonymously with peers who understand exam pressure, family expectations and job hunting.
community.sample1: Anyone else nervous about HSC results?
community.sample2: Same here. Want to do a study sprint together tonight?

arcade.title: Calm arcade
arcade.body: Breathing exercises and gentle games inspired by Bangladeshi art, for when you need a break.

toolkit.title: Career toolkit
toolkit.body: A career quiz built around Bangladeshi paths, and a resume builder with PDF export.

one.title: Create a free account
one.body: Sign up with email or Google. No payment, ever.

two.title: Make it yours
two.body: Pick your language, an anonymous name and what you want to work on.

three.title: Grow a little every day
three.body: Check in, write, breathe and connect. Small steps add up.

stats.title: Most people in Bangladesh never get mental health care
stats.subtitle: Initial findings from the National Mental Health Survey, Bangladesh 2019.

items.label: of adults aged 18–99 have a mental disorder
of children aged 7–17 have a mental disorder
of adults with a mental disorder receive no treatment

stats.source: Source: National Institute of Mental Health (NIMH) with technical support from WHO, National Mental Health Survey, Bangladesh 2019, initial findings. Published by WHO Bangladesh, 27 November 2019.
stats.closing: Bondhu cannot close that gap alone, but it can make the first step easier.

safety.title: Built with care, not hype
safety.body: Mental wellness is personal. Bondhu is designed to protect your privacy and to point you to real help when you need it.

private.title: Your journal is yours
private.body: Journal and mood entries are protected by database security rules. No one else can read them.

anonymous.title: Anonymous by default
anonymous.body: You post in the community under an alias, not your real name.

control.title: You stay in control
control.body: Download your data or delete your account whenever you want.

notMedical.title: Not a medical service
notMedical.body: Bondhu supports your wellbeing but does not replace a doctor, psychologist or counsellor.

help.title: Need help right now?
help.body: If you or someone you know is in immediate danger, call Bangladesh’s National Emergency Service. It is toll-free and open 24 hours a day, 7 days a week.
help.service: National Emergency Service · police, fire, ambulance
help.more: More verified helplines, including emotional support lines, are coming soon.

items.a: Yes. Every feature is free, with no ads and no premium plan.
No. Bondhu is a self-care and peer-support tool. If you are struggling, please reach out to a qualified mental health professional.
Only you. Journal entries stay private to your account and are never shown in the community.
Not in this version. The mentors are fictional demo profiles, clearly labelled, so you can try the booking flow.

items.q: Can I use it in Bangla?
items.a: Yes. Switch between বাংলা and English at any time from the top of the page.

items.q: Does it work on my phone?
items.a: Yes. Bondhu works in any modern browser on phones, tablets and computers.

cta.title: Take the first small step today
cta.body: Free, private and in your language.

shaplaBreath.title: Shapla Breath
shaplaBreath.tagline: Breathe with a blooming water lily.
shaplaBreath.howTo: Follow the shapla: breathe in as it blooms, hold, and breathe out as it closes. Sessions of one minute or more count.
shaplaBreath.doneTitle: Well done. Notice how you feel now.

478.name: 4-7-8 breathing
478.desc: In 4 · hold 7 · out 8. Helps you wind down.

box.name: Box breathing
box.desc: In 4 · hold 4 · out 4 · rest 4. Steady and grounding.

rickshawMemory.title: Rickshaw Memory Match
rickshawMemory.tagline: Match pairs of hand-drawn rickshaw-art cards.
rickshawMemory.howTo: Flip two cards at a time to find matching pairs of rickshaw-art motifs. Fewer moves and less time earn a higher score.

noukaDrift.title: Nouka Drift
noukaDrift.tagline: Drift down the river and gather lanterns.
noukaDrift.howTo: Guide your nouka along the river and gather floating lanterns from day into night. Bumping a log only slows you down, so there is nothing to lose.
noukaDrift.canvas: River scene. Move the boat with the up and down arrow keys, or by dragging.
noukaDrift.controls: Arrow keys or W/S to steer · drag or tap on touch screens · P to pause

shobdo.title: Shobdo (শব্দ)
shobdo.tagline: A new word to guess every day, in English or Bangla.
shobdo.howTo: Guess the day's word in six tries. Green means the right letter in the right place; yellow means it is in the word somewhere else. A new word arrives every day.
shobdo.lengthNoteBn_one: Today's word has {{formatted}} letter cluster (a letter with its vowel sign counts as one).
shobdo.lengthNoteBn_other: Today's word has {{formatted}} letter clusters (a letter with its vowel sign counts as one).
shobdo.invalid: Each tile needs a letter (a vowel sign cannot start a tile).
shobdo.comeBack: Come back tomorrow for a new word.
shobdo.shareFailed: Could not copy. Select the text below instead.

kanthaCanvas.title: Kantha Canvas
kanthaCanvas.tagline: Draw symmetric patterns inspired by nakshi kantha.
kanthaCanvas.howTo: Draw anywhere on the cloth and your stitches repeat around the centre, like a nakshi kantha. Save your design as a PNG when you are happy with it.
kanthaCanvas.canvas: Drawing cloth. Draw with a mouse, finger or pen; keyboard users can press G to add a generated motif.

bubblePop.title: Bubble Pop Calm
bubblePop.tagline: Pop a sheet of bubble wrap. Just because.
bubblePop.howTo: Pop every bubble on the sheet: click, tap, or use the arrow keys and Enter. A fresh sheet appears when you finish.
bubblePop.sheetDone: Sheet complete! Here comes a fresh one.
